package fixturepkg




























func TestPipelineReturnsDeferredActionWithoutApplyingIt(t *testing.T) {
	configuration := &Configuration{}
	require.NoError(t, initialize(configuration, map[string]SerializedValue{}, nil))
	logger := NewLogger()
	queue, err := NewQueue(logger, nil, NewDispatcher(logger), configuration, nil, nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	queue.root = func() (string, error) { return "fixture-root", nil }
	queue.calculate = func(
		_ context.Context,
		_ string,
		request CalculationRequest,
	) (*CalculationResult, error) {
		return directCalculationResult(request), nil
	}
	pipeline := &Pipeline{
		queue: queue, actions: map[string]deferredActionState{},
	}

	output, actions := pipeline.executeWithActions(
		context.Background(),
		ToolCall{
			CallID: "call-example", Name: "find_candidates",
			Arguments: json.RawMessage(`{
				"start":{"x":48.5,"y":-123.5},
				"end":{"x":48.6,"y":-123.4},
				"label":"Example Result"
			}`),
		},
		"principal:42",
		"conversation",
	)
	require.Len(t, actions, 1)
	require.Equal(t, "Example Result", actions[0].Label)
	require.True(t, actionPattern.MatchString(actions[0].ID))
	require.Empty(t, queue.storeData.ReadState().Applied)

	var result struct {
		Status  string           `json:"status"`
		Changed bool             `json:"changed"`
		Actions []DeferredAction `json:"actions"`
	}
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(output.Output), &result))
	require.Equal(t, "completed", result.Status)
	require.False(t, result.Changed)
	require.Equal(t, actions, result.Actions)
	require.Equal(t, "principal:42", pipeline.actions[actions[0].ID].principalID)

	dispatcher := NewDispatcher(logger)
	dispatcher.Register(
		"Pipeline.Apply",
		AccessAdmin,
		pipeline.apply,
		reflect.TypeFor[ApplyRequest](),
		reflect.TypeFor[ApplyResponse](),
	)
	requestBytes, err := serialize(&ApplyRequest{ActionID: actions[0].ID}, nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	responseBytes, handled, err := dispatcher.Fire(
		map[string]string{"actor-id": "principal:99"},
		"Pipeline.Apply",
		AccessAdmin,
		requestBytes,
	)
	require.True(t, handled)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	wrongPrincipalResponse := &ApplyResponse{}
	require.NoError(t, wrongPrincipalResponse.Deserialize(NewReader(responseBytes), nil))
	require.NotNil(t, wrongPrincipalResponse.Error)
	require.Empty(t, queue.storeData.ReadState().Applied)

	responseBytes, handled, err = dispatcher.Fire(
		map[string]string{"actor-id": "principal:42"},
		"Pipeline.Apply",
		AccessAdmin,
		requestBytes,
	)
	require.True(t, handled)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	applyResponse := &ApplyResponse{}
	require.NoError(t, applyResponse.Deserialize(NewReader(responseBytes), nil))
	require.Nil(t, applyResponse.Error)
	require.NotEmpty(t, queue.storeData.ReadState().Applied)
	_, stillAvailable := pipeline.actions[actions[0].ID]
	require.False(t, stillAvailable)
}
